description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WinForms application, with Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Native document scrollbars respect individual axes and survive a body-only Source round-trip without changing the document's rendering mode. Repeated Vertical assignments preserve body styles, and Preview retains live Unicode content through Source. Includes safe Ctrl+Click web and mail links, matching preview link handling, and searching from dialogs opened by host code. Opened documents keep their relative stylesheets and the editor's own head. Rebinding or disabling an action also stops its built-in shortcut.
title: SpiceLogic .NET WinForms HTML Editor Control
